# Copilot instructions

Everything in this repo is a **working draft**. The markdown files describe the current state of the analysis only. Git holds the history; the documents do not.

**Never write revision history into the prose.** When a score, flag, section or conclusion changes, replace the old text with the new and state the current reasoning — do not narrate the edit.

Forbidden in any doc:

- Version stamps in titles or headers ("Revised", "Revision 3", "v2")
- "What changed" / "Summary of changes" / changelog sections, promoted-demoted-added-cut lists
- Inline edit markers ("corrected this revision", "raised from E3", "NEW ROW", "flag changed from AVOID to MONITOR", "down from AVOID", "— new")
- Arguments against a former version of the same doc ("the previous version treated X as…", "this replaced the four-axis model", "restored after being dropped")
- Retained-for-comparison framing ("kept for the old view", "the score is unchanged")

Write "Why MONITOR rather than AVOID: …", not "flag changed from AVOID to MONITOR". Write "it still scores 4", not "the score is unchanged". A reader seeing the file for the first time should never learn that a different version existed.

**Not revision history — keep it:** critique of the external AgingBiotech source table and its omissions; trial and field history (ITP replication failures, retracted premises, pending readouts); the single date line under the title; analysis of the user's proposed protocols.

Keep [anti-aging-inventory.md](../anti-aging-inventory.md) and [therapeutics-by-mechanism.md](../therapeutics-by-mechanism.md) consistent — a score changed in one must change in the other and in the flat ranked list. Scoring convention: `E × B = score`, safety is a veto flag, effort is a tag outside the score.
